rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is younger.

example.english: The junior members of our team are still inexperienced.
example.traditional: 我哋隊入面啲後生仔仲未熟手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 deoi6 jap6 min6 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 zung6 mei6 suk6 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a lower-ranking or subordinate role, especially at work.

example.english: I’m only a junior employee in the company right now.
example.traditional: 我而家只係公司入面一個低級職員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zi2 hai6 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 jat1 go3 dai1 kap1 zik1 jyun4
